# Wireframes

Activity A asks for six. Two exist; five more are needed (the table in
`../ux/usability_findings.md` tracks which).

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `mockup_01_login_as_drawn.png` | The original login screen, as drawn. Titled "Login", carries registration fields, no password box, red-on-blue placeholders. Kept unedited — it is the "before" for Activity A. |
| `mockup_02_splash_as_drawn.png` | The original splash. Carried into the build essentially unchanged. |

**Do not edit these files.** They are the before state. Revisions go in as new
files alongside, so a before-and-after can be shown.

Pen-and-paper sketches are fine and often better: a hand sketch invites
criticism, a polished screen invites approval, and criticism is what the
activity is for. Photograph and drop them here.

Screenshots of the published prototype serve as a second set showing the
revised design.
